title: Denehurst Café launches weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk for families and loved ones
excerpt: Get Together After Serving CIC is inviting families and loved ones of fallen heroes to join a weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk at Denehurst Park.
body:
Get Together After Serving CIC is launching a weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk for families, partners, friends and loved ones of people who have died.

The weekly walk will take place every Wednesday, with participants meeting at 12.30pm outside Denehurst Café before walking around Denehurst Park.

The organisers say the walk will last between 30 minutes and one hour, depending on the weather. Dogs are welcome, although participants do not need to have a dog to take part.

The organisers say there is no expectation for participants to talk about their loss. People can share memories, talk about everyday life, walk quietly or simply spend time with others.

After the walk, participants will return to Denehurst Café for a warm drink and cake, providing an opportunity to continue spending time together.

Get Together After Serving CIC says the initiative is intended to provide an informal space for people affected by bereavement to walk, talk and spend time with others who understand the experience of loss.

Source: Get Together After Serving CIC.
